intro: The 351 Silver Star Squadron cannot operate without the active support from the community. While the Canadian government funds the basic operational costs, the squadron relies on ongoing support from local community to continue the high quality training activities and services we offer our cadets at no cost to them.
sponsorshipCall: To become a financial supporter of the 351 Silver Star Squadron, please contact the squadron sponsoring committee.

communitySupporters.thankYouMessage: Our sincere gratitude for the generous financial support from the following supporters:

volunteers.description: Volunteers are a crucial part of our organization. All volunteers are screened to ensure the integrity of the program. Please come talk to one of our SSC / staff if you are interested in joining us as a volunteer.

scholarship.title: WO Alfred Wong Memorial Scholarship
scholarship.description: The Warrant Officer Alfred Wong of 351 (Silver Star) Squadron Memorial Scholarship was created in 2007 in memory of this exceptional young man and outstanding cadet.
scholarship.criteria: For a Serving or Former Cadet Entering a Post-Secondary Music-related Program, or Enrolling in a Post-Secondary Program who was a Member of a Squadron Band for at Least Three Years.
scholarship.note: This scholarship is granted yearly to a deserving Air Cadet on a merit basis. Qualifying instructions and award application can be found on the scholarship package.
